title: Juz panjetan kisi se tawalla na chahiye
body:
Juz panjetan kisi se tawalla na chahiye
ghair az khuda kisi na bharosa na chahiye
<<DIVIDER>>
ek dar pe baith gar hai tawakkul kareem par
Allah ke faqeer ko phera na chahiye
<<DIVIDER>>
soughra ne shaahedee'n ko likha khat to bhejiye
gar chaahte nahi hume acha na chahiye
<<DIVIDER>>
do betiya'n to paas ho ek jaa'n balab bayeed
mai sach kahu ye aap ko baba na chahiye
<<DIVIDER>>
kehti thi fizza shaam me baazaario hato
Aale rasool par sitam aisa na chahiye
<<DIVIDER>>
ye koun bibiya'n hai tumhe kuch qabar nahi
zahra ki betio ka tamasha na chahiye
<<DIVIDER>>
kehta tha shimr chaadare bewo'n ki cheenlo
aise gunaah gaaro ko parda na chahiye
<<DIVIDER>>
marqad chiraaghe daagh se roushan rahe 'anees'
Shab ko akele ghar me andhera na chahiye
